issue: léwks-kʷe h₁ludʰés: 'and light came' has a 2sg verb with 3sg subject léwks; needs h₁ludʰét.
wódr̥h₂ gʷʰrént: neuter plural subject with 3pl verb, against the corpus convention (sg verb, as in 2e8047e7); expected gʷʰért.
wódr̥h₂ ... gʷh₂ént: neuter plural subject with 3pl verb, against the sg-verb convention (expected gʷéh₂t).
h₂éryomes 'we plough': root is *h₂erh₃- (Gk arotron, Lat. arāre), present expected *h₂érh₃ye-; the laryngeal is missing.
méǵh₂s h₁ési: masc./common predicate with neuter addressee móri (attributive méǵh₂ is correctly neuter in the same line); also wódr̥h₂ te h₁ludʰónt, neuter plural with 3pl verb against convention.
dʰéǵʰomn̥s lowkéyesi: acc. pl. 'the earths/lands' where the English has singular 'the earth' (acc. sg dʰéǵʰōm).
h₁yós stóygʰoh₁ lowkéyesi: stóygʰoh₁ is ins. sg / nom.-acc. dual, not the object 'the way'; needs acc. sg stóygʰom.
wíse 'Poison!': masculine-type vocative in -e for a neuter (*wisóm, Ved. viṣá- n.); neuters address with the nom./acc. form.

Scholarly-style text with notational inconsistencies: agʰnutór lacks the initial h₂ that the text writes elsewhere (h₂owey, h₂wl̥h₁náh₂); 'wept' for 'makes/weaves' can only be *webʰ-t with voicing assimilation; it is unrecognizable as written and is not 'makes'.

h₁yós póntoh₁m̥ lowkéyesi: masculine relative for neuter addressee sóh₂wl̥ (compare neuter h₁yód for fire in 1dc8b06f); also -kʷe hosted by clitic nos in gʷʰérmn̥ nos-kʷe léwkm̥ (expected léwkm̥-kʷe).
deywóybʰos is dat./abl. pl. 'to/from the gods', but the English is a vocative 'Gods, ...'; needs voc. deywṓs (as in 592e3084, 5434ef9f).

Scholarly-style text, inconsistent: ewewkʷ is singular (and endingless) with plural subject h₁éḱwōs; 'wool' is spelled h₂wlnéh₂m vs h₂wlh₂néh₂ (handbook *h₂wl̥h₁néh₂) and lacks syllabic marks (also widntbʰós).
h₂usbʰós h₁ludʰḗti 'Dawn will come': h₂usbʰós is dat./abl. pl.; subject needs nom. h₂éwsōs. Also voc. ḱérd for neuter 'heart' (expected nom.-form *ḱḗr).
